# clavis env diff

<p class="cli-lead">Compare key names between two environments</p>

<div class="cli-usage">

```sh
clavis env diff SOURCE TARGET
```

</div>

Compare two environments by key name: which keys exist in only one of
them. Values are not compared or shown. Use [`clavis promote`](./promote)
to see value differences and copy them.

## Examples

```sh
clavis env diff dev prod
clavis env diff staging production --json
```
